content.text: No MFN language exists anywhere in the agreement; §14.16 expressly confirms each party may contract freely with others.

input.quote: Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others.
input.rationale: The agreement contains no most-favoured-nation mechanic in either direction. The pricing provisions (§4.1 Charges, §4.2 Payment) simply refer Charges to Service Option Attachments and Order Forms and require payment of invoiced amounts; searches for "no less favorable", "most favored", "favourable", "best price", "discount" and "any other customer" return nothing. §14.16 (Freedom of Action) affirmatively states that each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others, which is inconsistent with any obligation on Bluefly to extend IBM the best terms it gives third parties. This matches the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer), so no redline is needed. Note only that there is likewise no MFN in our favour; that is a commercial ask rather than a playbook deviation.
